en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a group of Native American men performing a traditional dance outdoors on bare ground, with mountains faintly visible in the background and a wooden fence and bleachers with onlookers behind them. The dancers wear regalia including feathered headdresses, decorated garments, and leggings, and various items of clothing or blankets lie on the ground in the foreground. Printed red text at the top left identifies the scene, and there is cursive handwriting in dark ink at the top right.
